worldPv.title: Global Implementation of Balcony Solar
worldPv.lead: A framework view tracking how plug-in PV is expanding through lived experience: German legal reforms, Western legislation, and African off-grid implementations (Demo).

germany.name: Germany
germany.meterRequirement: Legacy reverse-spin temporarily allowed (smart meters rolling out)
germany.windSafety: Stow inside railing in high wind (flush clamps recommended)
germany.summary: Grid connection with Federal Network Agency (MaStR) registration only. Tenant install rights are law; adoption exceeds 1 million households.

austria.name: Austria
austria.incentives: Local environmental grants in some municipalities
austria.mountingRules: No-drill railing fix (appliance class; electrician not required)
austria.summary: Classed as a small appliance. A 2-week prior notice to the grid operator is enough for easy plug-in operation.

switzerland.name: Switzerland
switzerland.meterRequirement: Prior notice to the utility required
switzerland.windSafety: Snow load and Alpine wind resistance needed
switzerland.mountingRules: Outside-railing install needs written landlord consent
switzerland.summary: Plug-in allowed up to 600W rated. Inside the railing is freer; outside mounts need property-manager consent.

uk.name: United Kingdom (UK)
uk.antiIslanding: ENA G98 certified (stop within 0.5s on unplug)
uk.meterRequirement: Smart meter recommended (notify ENA within 28 days)
uk.windSafety: Coastal sites: 30 m/s wind rating or stow
uk.mountingRules: BS 1363 (fused 5A plug required; outdoor IP outlet)
uk.summary: With a fused 5A plug, up to 800W grid-tie via post-install notice to ENA within 28 days.

france.name: France
france.windSafety: Flatten or stow when high-wind warnings
france.summary: Free online CACSI filing to Enedis enables same-day use. DIY kits are widely sold at home centers.

italy.name: Italy
italy.meterRequirement: Bidirectional smart meter (≤350W needs no filing)
italy.windSafety: Mediterranean gusts: fixed or fold-away stow
italy.mountingRules: Railing clamps OK outside protected streetscape zones
italy.summary: Under ARERA rules, ≤350W needs no procedure. 350–800W is authorized via a simplified notice.

belgium.name: Belgium
belgium.meterRequirement: Digital smart meter required (no disc reverse-spin)
belgium.summary: To prevent reverse spin on legacy disc meters, plug-in grid-tie is allowed only in homes with digital meters.

usa.name: United States (US)
usa.incentives: Federal ITC 30% mainly tied to rooftop work
usa.windSafety: Hurricane/tornado regions: rigid wind ratings (110+ mph)
usa.mountingRules: Outlet plug-in treated as illegal wiring / HOA limits
usa.summary: NEC Rapid Shutdown rules generally ban outlet plug-in. Storage off-grid kits dominate the market.

china.name: China
china.meterRequirement: Bidirectional smart meter (direct multifamily plug-in not certified)
china.windSafety: High-rise wind / multi-point fall protection required
china.mountingRules: Property-manager approval is rare; installs behind safety nets
china.summary: The world's largest exporter of balcony PV gear (inverters, batteries). Domestic multifamily pilots are expanding.

japan.name: Japan
japan.baseLoadCoverage: Partial self-supply for night appliances / phones via portable storage
japan.meterRequirement: No reverse flow (no direct tie without RPR)
japan.windSafety: Typhoon stow indoors required / strict fall rules
japan.mountingRules: Condo rules often ban railing personal fixtures
japan.summary: Indoor wiring rules and interconnection talks still block outlet plug-in. Portable storage self-supply is mainstream.

until2020.title: Rooftop & FIT Era
until2020.description: Renewables centered on rooftop solar and FIT schemes. Plug-in panels remained a peripheral option.

from2021.title: EU Plug-in PV Expansion
from2021.description: Plug-in panel demand surged across the EU, accelerating debates on safety standards and output caps.

from2023.title: 800W Social Implementation
from2023.description: Germany and the EU clarified ~800W frameworks, enabling social rollout in rental and multifamily housing.

current.title: Global Bifurcation
current.description: World rollout is splitting between jurisdictions advancing legislation and regions leading with off-grid deployment.

germanyEu.name: Germany & EU
germanyEu.headline: Social rollout of the 800W plug-in solar framework
germanyEu.body: Legal reforms made simple balcony installs a realistic option. Clear output caps and lived-experience messaging are spreading together.

bullets.rentalMultifamily: Lower barriers for rental and multifamily housing

unitedStates.name: United States
unitedStates.headline: State and local institutionalization of plug-in PV
unitedStates.body: Rules are taking shape at the state and municipal level rather than federally. Rental incentives and differentiation from rooftop solar are key themes.

africaDeveloping.name: Africa & developing regions
africaDeveloping.headline: Balcony and facade solar on off-grid and weak grids
africaDeveloping.body: Where the grid is thin or absent, small panels and batteries are daily infrastructure. Modular, no-construction kits are the baseline.
